'''Nee Tonna''' was a [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who, by [[3630 BBY]], was wanted by the [[Eternal Empire]] for theft, sabotage and operating a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] without a license. He was last seen in the lower levels of the Empire's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Zakuul]] and his wanted poster was displayed in the [[Overwatch]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nee Tonna appears during '''Chapter 10: Anarchy in Paradise''' of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' on a wanted holo-poster.
